citations.quote:
[name="空爆"]泡普卡，你没事……吧？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_282_catap_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="空爆"]呃，你什么时候换衣服了？还怪好看的。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_282_catap_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="空爆"]这些人又是谁？长得不像我们刚才要收拾的沙盗啊？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$rungeneral", volume=1,channel="8")]
[StopSound(channel="8",fadetime=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#1",posfrom="-150,0",posto="0,0",afrom=0, ato=1,duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#3",focus="m")]
[name="梓兰"]泡普卡……？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]（东国语？）你们是何人，为什么会知道吾的名字叫宝巫迦？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_282_catap_1#5$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="l",name="char_278_orchid_1#1",focus="r")]
[name="空爆"]梓兰姐说的还真没错，仔细一听居然真的是东国语，月见夜教我的我都要忘了……
[charslot(slot="l",name="char_278_orchid_1#2",focus="l")]
[name="梓兰"]你就是忘了吧。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_282_catap_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="空爆"]哪有！我还等着哪天去东国旅游呢，不信你听着！
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_282_catap_1#2$1",focus="r")]
[Delay(time=1)]
[multiline(name="空爆")]（东国语）咳咳，
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_282_catap_1#9$1",focus="r")]
[multiline(name="空爆")]泡普卡，你到底跑哪里去了，我们找你找得好辛苦！
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]吾一直就在这里——
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="char_278_orchid_1#1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_282_catap_1#3$1",focus="r")]
[name="空爆"]你看，我说我会吧！
[charslot(slot="l",name="char_278_orchid_1#3",focus="l")]
[name="梓兰"]不，事情好像没那么简单……
[charslot(slot="l",name="char_278_orchid_1#1",focus="l")]
[name="梓兰"]泡普卡，你不认识我们了吗？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="宝巫迦")]吾为何要认识你们……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="宝巫迦")]等等，你们的装扮，还有刚才所用的语言……莫非……
[stopmusic(fadetime=0.5)]
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_fsmummy", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2112_1#1$1",afrom=0, ato=1,duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=2.5)]
[PlayMusic(intro="$tense_intro", key="$tense_loop", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]这是——“诅咒”！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_282_catap_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="空爆"]“诅咒”？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2106_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="领头武士"]陛下，这里交给我们——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]说什么蠢话。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]吾岂有丢下尔等独自离开的道理？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]况且，吾要找的“异兽猎人”已经找到了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2106_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="领头武士"]难道这两位就是——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]不会错的。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="char_278_orchid_1#1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_282_catap_1#11$1",focus="r")]
[name="空爆"]梓兰姐，是不是有什么地方不太对……？这还是我们认识的泡普卡吗？
[charslot(slot="l",name="char_278_orchid_1#5",focus="l")]
[name="梓兰"]倒不如说，就没有对的地方……
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]两位旅人……你们可愿意协助吾狩猎这些被“诅咒”的野兽？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="char_278_orchid_1#3",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_282_catap_1#11$1",focus="l")]
[name="梓兰"]……泡普卡，你到底——
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]若吾的猜测没有错，两位现在恐怕充满困惑。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]待狩猎结束后，吾自当为两位解惑。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="char_278_orchid_1#3",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_282_catap_1#11$1",focus="r")]
[name="空爆"]怎么办，梓兰姐？
[charslot(slot="l",name="char_278_orchid_1#2",focus="l")]
[name="梓兰"]还能怎么办？准备战斗吧。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_282_catap_1#3$1",focus="r")]
[name="空爆"]哈，这个我擅长！
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, style = "slider", inverse = true, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#1",focus="m")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, style = "slider", inverse = false, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_cndlextngsh", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#3",focus="m")]
[Delay(time=1)]
[name="梓兰"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_282_catap_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="空爆"]梓兰姐，你怎么了？
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#5",focus="m")]
[name="梓兰"]我的伞好像出了点问题——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_282_catap_1#11$1",focus="m")]
[name="空爆"]啊？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_282_catap_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="空爆"]那就交给我吧！吃我一发！
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$grenade_launcher_shot", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",posfrom="0,0",posto="-30,0",focus="m",duration=1)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$grenade_explosion", volume=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=50, ystrength=50, vibrato=60, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2112_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_282_catap_1#11$1",focus="m")]
[name="空爆"]梓兰姐，有点奇怪！
[name="空爆"]这些钳兽怎么会这么顽强？
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2112_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#1",focus="m")]
[name="梓兰"]那些黑气……
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#3",focus="m")]
[name="梓兰"]泡普卡，你刚才说的“诅咒”是怎么回事！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]“诅咒”，是“异兽”带来的灾厄，它会依附于野兽之上，让野兽变得极为凶暴。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_282_catap_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="空爆"]我怎么越听越迷糊？！
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="梓兰"]简单来说，就是让野兽变得更加狂暴的东西……
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#1",focus="m")]
[name="梓兰"]没有什么解决方法吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]一旦野兽被“诅咒”，就只能用尽全力将其消灭。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]否则的话，一旦“诅咒”传播开，就会引发一些让人匪夷所思的现象！
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#3",focus="m")]
[name="梓兰"]居然有这种事？！
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$leaveshake")]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2112_1#1$1",afrom=0, ato=1,duration=1)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2112_1#1$1",afrom=0, ato=1,duration=1.3)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#4",focus="m")]
[name="梓兰"]不行，这样下去没完没了了！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]必须把这些被“诅咒”的野兽在这里消灭，否则的话，“诅咒”会蔓延，而且——
